newsitem.title: JAPAN: MITSUI CON SHARES RISE ON RESTRUCTURING PLAN.
newsitem.headline: MITSUI CON SHARES RISE ON RESTRUCTURING PLAN.

text.p: Shares of Mitsui Construction Co Ltd rose 41 yen to trade at 211 yen on the Tokyo Stock Exchange in the afternoon session on Thursday after being bid-only for most of the day.
The issue attracted buying following Wednesday's announcement of the company's three-year restructuring plan, brokers said.

Under the plan, the company aims to post a parent current profit of 10 billion yen in 1999/00 by winning 460 billion yen worth of construction orders and completing 455 billion yen worth of projects in that year.
The company also aims to cut liabilities, including interest-bearing debts and guarantees on affiliates' debts, by 74 billion yen by 1999 and reduce workforce by 400 over the next three years.
The company has also obtained support for its restructuring efforts from other Mitsui group members, including Sakura Bank Ltd and Mitsui Fudosan Co Ltd.
